about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Micro-finance Officer gives and recovers small loans to low-income borrowers - usually women's groups in villages and towns - and helps them use credit well. It is a field role with microfinance institutions and small finance banks.

items.text: Check borrowers' eligibility and complete KYC
Guide borrowers on responsible borrowing and savings
Learn accounting, banking and rural economics
Study RBI's microfinance rules and fair-practice code
Learn credit appraisal for small loans
Learn mobile banking apps used in the field
Intern with an MFI or small finance bank
Do a project on SHG repayment or financial literacy
